canonical_statement: Let X be a normal projective variety over a field of characteristic zero, let Delta be an effective Q-divisor such that K_X + Delta is Q-Cartier and (X, Delta) is klt, and let D be a Cartier divisor. If D - (K_X + Delta) is nef and big, then H^i(X, O_X(D)) = 0 for every i > 0.

canonical_formal_target.status: worker-elaborated statement interface; provisional pending master acceptance; no proof claimed

domain_and_universes: A characteristic-zero field k; a normal projective k-variety X; an effective Q-divisor Delta with K_X + Delta Q-Cartier and klt pair (X, Delta); a Cartier divisor D on X.
hypotheses: the pair (X, Delta) is Kawamata log terminal
D - (K_X + Delta) is nef and big
conclusion: H^i(X, O_X(D)) = 0 for every positive integer i
excluded_degenerate_cases: No dimension or algebraic-closure restriction is added. Log-canonical pairs, positive characteristic, relative vanishing, analytic formulations, and claims for nonpositive cohomological degree are outside this frozen root.
